name: Title — The Ashen Crown
direction: Slow restrained strings, bells and low pulse; end on an unresolved suspension.

name: Dain — An Open Hand
direction: Low brass and plucked strings; a repeated note opens into a fifth.

name: Tessa — Borrowed Light
direction: Bright mallet and woodwind phrase that learns to leave space.

name: Corren — The Return
direction: Airy flute over grounded hand percussion, not a constant heroic march.

name: Ivo — Working Hands
direction: Muted metallic percussion and bass ostinato with a warm middle voice.

name: Nera — Every Road
direction: Dry plucked strings, small woodwind replies, forward but unhurried motion.

name: Oriel — The Right to Refuse
direction: Breathy reed and distant bell; clear rests between phrases.

name: Sable — Unwritten
direction: Tight counterpoint loosening into a single candid melody.

name: Pip — Names We Keep
direction: Playful offbeat figure that later returns with fewer evasive ornaments.

name: Brackenford — Shift Change
direction: Warm domestic rhythm against a distant industrial pulse.

name: Veyr — Oath Square
direction: Ordered brass and precise percussion with subtle harmonic tension.

name: Cinderwake — The Cooling Garden
direction: Steam-like noise texture used sparingly, gentle machine rhythm.

name: Bellharbor — Tide and Paper
direction: Bell and flute over a rocking bass; no direct sea-shanty quotation.

name: High Aerie — Returners’ Hall
direction: Open intervals and audible breathing room.

name: Nacre — Listening Water
direction: Sparse chords, plucked mineral tones, restrained reverb.

name: Hearthward — Many Small Fires
direction: Main theme in warm intimate instrumentation, repaired rather than triumphant.

name: Before the Fault
direction: Confident travel pulse; leave room for footsteps and menu cues.

name: After the Fault
direction: Same melodic identity with missing bass notes and changed cadence.

name: Wayfarer — Ordinary Flight
direction: Lift and motion without a military fanfare; combines Ivo and Corren motifs.

name: Quarry and Conduit
direction: Low ostinato and metallic emphasis; two arrangement states.

name: Rootward
direction: Organic percussion and short recurring flute calls.

name: Furnace Spine
direction: Layered rhythmic machinery; audible rest sections before major scenes.

name: Drowned Archive
direction: Bell fragments and rippling counterpoint with a clear tonal center.

name: Memory Vault
direction: Contradictory voices resolve only after the listening scene.

name: Encounter — Broken Orders
direction: Brisk syncopation, memorable bass line and readable transition into victory.

name: Boss — Pressure Rising
direction: Strong ostinato and contrasting bridge; avoid endless identical two-bar loops.

name: Catastrophe — Crown of Cinders
direction: Begins with intended release, fractures into displaced rhythm, ends in silence.

name: Crown Vessel — No One Is Fuel
direction: Three connected arrangements for the three phases; transitions on musical boundaries.

name: Victory and Rest
direction: Short separate victory, recovery and discovery cues sharing the core interval.

name: The First Unborrowed Morning
direction: Complete the title’s suspended cadence; include character fragments without quoting other games.
